title: iMuon: Intrinsic Spectral Optimization on Riemannian Matrix Manifolds
abstract: arXiv:2605.09238v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Muon and related norm-constrained optimizers, now central to large-scale learning, compute updates via a linear maximization oracle (LMO) over a matrix-norm ball in Euclidean space. However, they do not generalize cleanly to manifold-valued parameters such as low-rank factorizations, orthogonality constraints, or symmetric positive-definite (SPD) matrices. Naively restricting the Muon LMO to the tangent space (i) breaks quotient symmetries and (ii) couples the tangent-space constraint with an ambient norm bound, which obstructs closed-form solutions. We resolve both issues with a key observation: every Riemannian metric canonically lifts a unitarily invariant Euclidean norm to an intrinsic norm on each tangent space. translated_title: iMuon：黎曼矩阵流形上的内蕴谱优化
translated_abstract: Muon 及相关的范数约束优化器如今已成为大规模学习的核心方法，它们通过在欧几里得空间中的矩阵范数球上执行线性最大化预言机（LMO）来计算更新。然而，这些方法无法干净地推广到流形值参数，例如低秩分解、正交约束或对称正定（SPD）矩阵。若简单地将 Muon 的 LMO 限制在切空间上，会 破坏商对称性，并 使切空间约束与环境范数界相互耦合，从而阻碍闭式解的求解。我们通过一个关键观察解决了这两个问题：任何黎曼度量都能规范地将一个酉不变的欧几里得范数提升为每个切空间上的内蕴范数。由此得到的内蕴 LMO 能保持对称性，并且在缩放切空间满足某一结构条件下，可退化为标准的欧几里得 LMO。基于此，我们提出了内蕴 Muon（iMuon），一个统一的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文提出 iMuon 优化器，通过将黎曼度量规范地把酉不变的欧几里得范数提升为切空间上的内蕴范数，解决了 Muon 推广到低秩、正交、SPD 等矩阵流形时的对称性破坏与闭式解受阻问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces iMuon, which generalizes the Muon optimizer to Riemannian matrix manifolds (low-rank, orthogonal, SPD) by canonically lifting unitarily invariant Euclidean norms into intrinsic tangent-space norms, resolving symmetry-breaking and closed-form obstacles.
